description: Electricity consumption - all meters is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. Postcode level electricity consumption for all domestic meters (2023). See the official notes for this dataset for full information on the metadata. Data have been subset to the region by postcode and additional fields added for geo reference purposes. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Energy, carbon, CO2, Housing, electricity. The portal shows 24,105 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
